question: Is the design sound, and what happens to AC6, which is a Captain call?

artifacts.summary: Decisive finding: a slug collision is not a duplicate, so the kata's guess (teach dupcheck target-slug awareness) would make it reject genuinely new sources — worse than the bug. Design instead reuses dupcheck as a URL-to-owning-file lookup, which is exactly what separates a legitimate --force re-ingest from a real collision; verified to find even a hand-renamed slug no rule would generate. Defect is wider than reported: same-host collisions exist and query-stripping collapses every HN item to 'item', hence the numeric tail. --summary-only correctly in scope as the fix's own second-order consequence. Option (b) costed as a five-step migration and declined. AC6 (suffix shape) declared interactive and carried forward unsatisfied — mechanism is independent of the token, nothing is renamed, no ingest runs before the Captain wakes. Recommend approve.
